• 1/2 cup of ice cream is about the size of a tennis ball.

• Use cups, teaspoons, and tablespoons to record amounts. 
Figure 3.3 Food Diary
In the clinical setting, visual observation of food consumed is used to estimate nutritional intake. In the research setting, actual
weighing of the food prior to and after the meal provides a precise measurement.
